items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I'd catch a cab and go to work for Burke Bailey until around 11 o'clock.

ctx.x: And you'd do that after you got through with Abernathy?
After I got through with Abernathy, we worked until two o'clock on Saturday night then I'd catch a cab and go to work for Burke Bailey until around 11 o'clock.
What sort of place was that?
